title: Twenty zero-flag HD 26965 rows have DRS velocities near 41535 km/s in HARPS RVBank v02
abstract: We audit 603 public HD 26965 exposures. Twenty rows on four nights have DRS velocities near 41535 km/s, zero row flags, and errors near 1 m/s. All have RVGUESS = 41518. The same exposures give small relative SERVAL velocities. Two original ESO headers contain a target velocity input of 41517.640 km/s. A normal comparison header gives -42.500 km/s. This supports a metadata or reduction error. A constant shift leaves 214 m/s of scatter in the extreme DRS group. Five other zero-flag rows with RVGUESS = 0 have gross errors. This extends a prior campaign audit of GJ 1061 to a separate target. After a gross error guard, a fixed 42.38-day wave reduces held-season error by about 18 percent in 67 nights from eight seasons. Descriptive season resampling ranges include zero and are not confidence limits. Simple shared activity slopes raise error. These tests do not confirm or exclude a planet. The reductions share spectra, and independent NEID work already favors activity. Code, aggregate results, figures, exact source hashes, and external retrieval steps are included. Raw records remain external.

display.caption: The extreme DRS group follows a large target velocity input. A constant shift leaves large scatter. All 20 extreme rows have zero flags.
